name: Chaos Blood Magick

phase_0.boundary_condition: The operator skin and the temporary belief boundary

VINIT.justification: The void state before belief is crystallized and before the physical sacrifice begins

TANCH.chosen_element: Closed belief boundary and ritual circle
TANCH.justification: The terminal anchor that contains the chaotic paradigm shift and separates the ritual space from the profane world

AFWD.justification: The forward morphism that directs the self-authored sigil into the environment to alter reality

AREV.justification: The reverse descent where life force is consumed and the physical toll is internalized by the operator

CLINK.chosen_element: Chaining of sigil drawing and bloodletting
CLINK.justification: The sequential composition that links the cognitive act of belief with the physical act of sacrifice

IMSCRIB.justification: The identity operation where the operator recognizes themselves as the sole source of the magical effect

FSPLIT.justification: The co-multiplication that divides the unified operator into the cognitive belief-state and the physical blood-state

FFUSE.justification: The multiplication that reunites the belief-state and blood-state into a single post-ritual operator

EVALT.chosen_element: Successful manifestation of the chaotic paradigm
EVALT.justification: The affirmative branch where the belief successfully alters the target reality

EVALF.chosen_element: Failure of belief resulting in mere physical injury
EVALF.justification: The negative branch where the paradigm shift collapses and only the physical blood loss remains

ENGAGR.chosen_element: Simultaneous holding of contradictory beliefs during physical depletion
ENGAGR.justification: The paradice where the operator maintains absolute belief and absolute doubt at the exact moment of sacrifice

IFIX.chosen_element: Permanent psychological scar and physical mark
IFIX.justification: The irreversible ROM fixation that records the ritual outcome in the operator's neurology and tissue

phase_2.split_input: The unified operator before the ritual
phase_2.fuse_result: The unified operator after the ritual

phase_3.void_description: The state before belief is formed and before blood is drawn
phase_3.true_description: The state where the paradigm shift successfully alters reality
phase_3.false_description: The state where the belief collapses and only physical damage remains
phase_3.both_description: The paradice of holding contradictory beliefs while sustaining physical depletion

steps.domain_action: Initialize the void of unformed intent and unshed blood
Establish the closed belief boundary and the temporary ritual space
Assert the self-referential recognition of the operator authority
Bifurcate the operator into the belief-state and the physical-state
Project the chaotic belief outward to shape the paradigm
Affirm the successful alignment of belief and intent
Draw the physical sacrifice inward and consume life force
Register the physical depletion and the risk of belief collapse
Reconstitute the operator from the belief-state and physical-state
Hold the paradice of absolute belief and absolute doubt simultaneously
Chain the sigil drawing with the bloodletting in sequential composition
Record the permanent psychological scar and physical mark

phase_5.memory_mechanism: The psychological imprint and physical scar tissue
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: The criticality of the ritual moment and astrological timing
phase_5.alfs_store: The grimoire of self-authored sigils and personal mythos

phase_6.cycle_cost: The metabolic energy of blood loss and the cognitive load of maintaining belief

phase_6.post_cycle_state: The unified operator with altered paradigm and depleted blood volume
